lyrics: They locked the heavy doors on   the chamber hall
No debate on the floor, no roll call
A quiet little whisper and   a stroke of the pen
And they’re sending out the hometown   boys again
There was no declaration   for
the people to see
Just a late-night memo   and
a shadow decree
It's the unapproved war, flying under
the night No hands raised up in   the morning light They bypassed the gavel
and they buried the law Feeding the   belly of the unapproved war
Yeah, the     people
didn't        speak,
but the people will pay
For the unapproved war at
the end of the day.
Millions of dollars moving   over the wire
To throw a little fuel   on an endless fire
The Constitution is a ghost in the marble hall
While the executives rise and the young men fall
They wrap up the treason   in
a security brief
And leave the working man alone
with the grief
It's the unapproved war, flying under the night
No hands raised up   in the morning light
They bypassed the gavel   and they buried the law Feeding the belly of the unapproved war
Yeah, the people
didn't speak, but the people
will pay
For the       unapproved war at
the end       of the day.
The loudest sound in the capital...
Is the silence of the vote.
They took the voice of the people!
And shoved it down our throat!
No declaration.
No consent.
Just the unapproved
war.
